thread:
elaine: deploy-bot is reporting a canary p95 spike (~+26%) for /embeddings in us-west during the v2.6 rollout. Its suggesting auto-revert. We need a quick decision: let it auto-run or do a surgical routing carveout?
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +26% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold exceeded. Suggested action: auto-rollback. [telemetry link]
sahir: Oncall here. Are 5xxs trending up? Any CS tickets?
elaine: No increase in 5xxs, no user tickets so far. Latency and KVcache miss rate both spiked after a kernel change introduced in the new binary.
mohit: If errors are flat, full revert is noisy. We can carve out embeddings route to previous binary for a subset of traffic — check signal — then either ramp back or do full revert.
release-owner: I prefer the minimal blast radius. Approve surgical carveout if oncall signs off.
notifier-bot: POLICY: Partial routing pins during change windows require approval by oncall + release-owner. Manual action will suppress auto-revert.
sahir: I approve the manual carveout. Mohit, please execute and monitor p95 and kvcache for 5m.
mohit: Running command now: ```redwood route update --service=embeddings --to-version=1.5.1 --scope=40% --ramp=90s --reason="canary p95 spike"```
mohit: change applied, ramping 40% -> monitoring.
deploy-bot: ACTION: routing change detected. embeddings -> 1.5.1 (scope 40%). Auto-revert suppressed while manual intervention active.
mohit: Observability: pinned slice p95 dropped ~20% within 60s; KVcache misses reduced for that slice. Overall embeddings p95 back to acceptable range after ramp to 100% (completed).
elaine: Good outcome. No customer-facing errors observed. Mohit, leave rollout paused and open an RCA ticket to reproduce kernel flags in staging. Sahir/release-owner, any objections to publishing a short note?
sahir: No objections.
release-owner: Go ahead. Include that we performed a targeted routing fallback to previous binary (v1.5.1) and paused the rollout pending investigation.
elaine: Drafted blurb: "During a staged rollout we observed increased latency for embeddings-only requests. We performed a targeted routing fallback to the previous stable binary (v1.5.1) and paused the rollout. No user-facing errors were reported. Engineering will investigate a kernel interaction that increased cache misses and will follow up with an RCA." Posting to #release-notes and notifying CS.
notifier-bot: RECORD: manual partial rollback executed by mohit; approved by sahir and release-owner. Incident state: mitigated.
